name: wake
label: Dec 8, 1941 (Wake Island)
to_notes: v1.7.41: the island moved 500 m east (the mod has it in the game's far south-west corner, x -3000..-1571): its runway cell had no collision at x < about -2700 while a cell east of it had (log 107: the car in the sea at the arrival, the apron by the planters solid) - the game's world has an edge there
notes: Wake Island v1.1 by nine30 (a map for GTA IV): five archives (wake_main, wake_props, wake_stream, us_carrier, ship_intro) and the GTA V trees it adds to ext_veg.img, merged into one source directory; placed where the mod put it, in the open sea south-west of Alderney (the stock sea covers it). 745 of its placements are the game's own props and bushes (stock pieces, no files), 168 vegetation (16 GTA V models placed many times, the rest the game's), 368 its own models each placed once.

collision.notes: v1.7.37: the mod's 52 world-space collision files cover regions (the ground, rocks, palms, the ship, the carrier's decks and rooms), not models: cut into 150 m cells carried by invisible pieces. col_arbre_1 repeats col_arbre's trees (same polygons and box).

tiles.notes: 64 models over 100 m in radius (the sea floor, the ground, roads, the runway, rock lines, palm and bush clusters, the carrier's hull) cut into tiles of 150 m; render triangles wholly over 3 m under the sea dropped.

stream_notes: v1.7.38: the pieces within 700 m of the player stand (a sixth farther once made), the rest wait: at once, the set's 1,600 pieces filled the game's streaming memory (log 104: 260 of 268 MB with 659 of 820 models in; the car sank by the runway, the world stopped streaming)
plant_notes: v1.7.37: not planted: the GTA V trees placed one by one stand on the mod's visible ground exactly, its collision runs up to 1.5 m over that ground in places (a poor guide), and its tree clusters (MW3 trees) have canopy pieces a grouping can't tell from plants; left as the mod placed them.

life.notes: v1.7.37: the mod's car generators (its dinghies, jeeps, bikes, the carrier's helicopters); airmen, sailors and troopers about the player; the weather SUNNY_WINDY (2); the trainer's own wind, surf, a gull and a plane passing.
life.creature_notes: v1.7.39: GTA V animals as creatures the trainer moves (creature.py: the JAWS great white, StrideR's crocodile, indirivacua's elephant): how many of each kind are kept about the player

arrive_notes: the runway's south-east end, the whole runway ahead (the longest flat run found starts 80 m further up it)
